children: Many ecommerce brands hit a plateau when scaling on traditional platforms. Here are the most common pain points we hear:
On standard platforms, transaction costs eat away at your profit margins. For stores processing high sales volumes, even a small percentage adds up to thousands of dollars every month.
RunningB2B and B2C on separate systems creates chaos. Managing two stores, two inventories, and two customer experiences slows down growth and increases costs.
Slow checkout processes, poor UI/UX, and limited customization options often result in abandoned carts. Withoutpersonalized experiences , even heavy traffic fails to convert.
Expanding globally requires support for multiple currencies, languages, and localized experiences. Most platforms can’t handle this seamlessly, leading to lost opportunities.
